name: Triparty Collateral Transaction Instruction V 01
definition: Scope:|This message is sent by a trading party to its triparty agent to instruct the agent to perform a specific action on a collateral management transaction.|It is also sent by an account owner to an account servicer where the account servicer manages the account at the triparty agent on behalf of the trading party. The account owner may be a global custodian which manages an account with a triparty agent on behalf of their client or an investment management institution or a broker/dealer which has an account with their custodian.||Usage:|The triparty collateral management service is used by two trading parties at the agreement of a business transaction (for example, a repo, a securities loan, ... ) when they want to secure the transaction with collateral. The management of this collateral (that is, agreeing on quantity and type, marking to market, ... ) is done by a third party, the triparty collateral manager.||Before starting to use these services, the three parties will first sign a contract in which they stipulate the rules of the agreement.

TransactionInstructionIdentification.name: Transaction Instruction Identification
TransactionInstructionIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the instruction or the transaction as known by the instructing  or the receiving party.

Linkages.name: Linkages
Linkages.definition: Link to another transaction (or instruction) that must be processed after, before or at the same time.

Pagination.name: Pagination
Pagination.definition: Page number of the message and continuation indicator to indicate that the multi-part preliminary advice is to continue or that the message is the last page of the multi-part preliminary advice.

GeneralParameters.name: General Parameters
GeneralParameters.definition: Specifies the different parameters of the collateral transaction or instruction.

CollateralParties.name: Collateral Parties
CollateralParties.definition: Identifies the chain of collateral parties.

DealTransactionDetails.name: Deal Transaction Details
DealTransactionDetails.definition: Specifies the information related to the deal.

DealTransactionDate.name: Deal Transaction Date
DealTransactionDate.definition: Identifies the dates related to the triparty collateral instruction or transactions.

OtherParties.name: Other Parties
OtherParties.definition: Other business parties relevant to the transaction.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.

Securities lending and Transaction Amoun.definition: If deal transaction details is present and that collateral exposure is securities lending or borrowing then transaction amount is optional otherwise it is mandatory.
